note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Relationships are drawn only as supplied (no arrowheads unless a causal link is supplied). Party C is a generic fictional newcomer; her card is a request to intervene shown only as supplied (never as granted or refused). The initial relation and the intervention requested are supplied configurations of equal weight; nothing states a rule for intervention.
